name: After Hours #5 — Laundry on the Roof
description: Sheets becoming flags. The city is a quiet instrument under the clotheslines. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 5 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 3-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
